event_detail: Steak: the gripper descends onto the steak on the plate, closes, and lifts away toward the cutting board, but the steak stays on the plate.
evidence: Knife lies on the cutting board in every frame (stage 1 done). Wrist camera: at 27.2-28.8 s the open gripper is right over the steak; at 30.4 s the fingers are closed and the camera has risen, with the steak still lying on the plate; at 32.0 s the gripper moves left toward the cutting board (board edge visible) while the steak remains on the plate behind. Shoulder views also show the steak still on the plate at 32.0 s and nothing in the gripper.
